title: 经历叙述与回忆 · 100 句
description: 故事背景、动作顺序、意外、误会、努力、童年、人物、反思与结尾。

items.zh: 事情发生在一个普通的周二。
items.en: It happened on an ordinary Tuesday.
answers: It happened on an ordinary Tuesday.

items.zh: 我那时刚搬到附近。
items.en: I had only just moved nearby.
answers: I had only just moved nearby.

items.zh: 一开始我没觉得有什么异常。
items.en: At first, nothing seemed unusual.
answers: At first, nothing seemed unusual.

items.zh: 我们原本只打算待一小时。
items.en: We had intended to stay for an hour.
answers: We had intended to stay for an hour.

items.zh: 那是我第一次独自出远门。
items.en: It was my first long journey alone.
answers: It was my first long journey alone.

items.zh: 我当时不知道这件事会持续多久。
items.en: I did not know how long it would last.
answers: I did not know how long it would last.
I didn't know how long it would last.

items.zh: 这段回忆从一个电话开始。
items.en: The memory begins with a phone call.
answers: The memory begins with a phone call.

items.zh: 我还记得房间里的气味。
items.en: I still remember the smell of the room.
answers: I still remember the smell of the room.

items.zh: 我们认识时都很紧张。
items.en: We were both nervous when we met.
answers: We were both nervous when we met.

items.zh: 我差点没有接受邀请。
items.en: I nearly declined the invitation.
answers: I nearly declined the invitation.

items.zh: 雨已经下了一整夜。
items.en: It had been raining all night.
answers: It had been raining all night.

items.zh: 街上比平时安静。
items.en: The street was quieter than usual.
answers: The street was quieter than usual.

items.zh: 那时候我每天坐同一班车。
items.en: I took the same bus every day then.
answers: I took the same bus every day then.

items.zh: 屋子很小，但光线充足。
items.en: The room was small but bright.
answers: The room was small but bright.

items.zh: 我们手头没有地图。
items.en: We had no map with us.
answers: We had no map with us.

items.zh: 我已经连续工作了好几天。
items.en: I had been working for several days.
answers: I had been working for several days.

items.zh: 墙上挂着一只慢钟。
items.en: A slow clock hung on the wall.
answers: A slow clock hung on the wall.

items.zh: 门外的人没有说话。
items.en: The person outside said nothing.
answers: The person outside said nothing.

items.zh: 大家似乎都知道计划，只有我不知道。
items.en: Everyone seemed to know the plan except me.
answers: Everyone seemed to know the plan except me.

items.zh: 我当时对那座城市完全陌生。
items.en: The city was entirely new to me.
answers: The city was entirely new to me.

items.zh: 我先敲门，然后等了一会儿。
items.en: I knocked, then waited a moment.
answers: I knocked, then waited a moment.

items.zh: 刚坐下，灯就灭了。
items.en: I had just sat down when the lights went out.
answers: I had just sat down when the lights went out.

items.zh: 我回头时，他已经离开了。
items.en: When I turned round, he had gone.
answers: When I turned round, he had gone.

items.zh: 她递来纸条，什么也没解释。
items.en: She handed me a note without explaining.
answers: She handed me a note without explaining.

items.zh: 我们走了几步才发现少了一人。
items.en: We walked a little before noticing someone was missing.
answers: We walked a little before noticing someone was missing.

items.zh: 直到走到门口，我才发现自己拿错了钥匙。
items.en: Only when I reached the door did I realise I had brought the wrong key.
answers: Only when I reached the door did I realise I had brought the wrong key.
items.notes: only + 时间从句置于句首，主句部分倒装；had brought 表示更早的动作。

items.zh: 车停稳以后，我们才下车。
items.en: We waited until the vehicle had come to a complete stop before getting out.
answers: We waited until the vehicle had come to a complete stop before getting out.
items.notes: come to a complete stop：完全停稳；get out：下车。

items.zh: 他把东西放下，又回了房间。
items.en: He put it down and returned to the room.
answers: He put it down and returned to the room.

items.zh: 我读完信后又读了一遍。
items.en: After finishing the letter, I read it again.
answers: After finishing the letter, I read it again.

items.zh: 谈话被突然响起的电话打断。
items.en: A ringing phone interrupted the conversation.
answers: A ringing phone interrupted the conversation.

items.zh: 包比我记得的重得多。
items.en: The bag was much heavier than I remembered.
answers: The bag was much heavier than I remembered.

items.zh: 我们等的人竟然早到了。
items.en: The person we were waiting for had arrived early.
answers: The person we were waiting for had arrived early.

items.zh: 我没想到他还认得我。
items.en: I had not expected him to recognise me.
answers: I had not expected him to recognise me.
I hadn't expected him to recognise me.

items.zh: 地图上的小路已经消失了。
items.en: The path on the map no longer existed.
answers: The path on the map no longer existed.

items.zh: 原来声音来自楼下。
items.en: The sound turned out to come from downstairs.
answers: The sound turned out to come from downstairs.

items.zh: 盒子里不是我们订的东西。
items.en: The box did not contain what we ordered.
answers: The box did not contain what we ordered.
The box didn't contain what we ordered.

items.zh: 偏偏那天我忘了充电。
items.en: That was the day I forgot to charge it.
answers: That was the day I forgot to charge it.

items.zh: 我们同时想到了同一个办法。
items.en: The same idea occurred to both of us.
answers: The same idea occurred to both of us.

items.zh: 最难的部分比预想的容易。
items.en: The hardest part was easier than anticipated.
answers: The hardest part was easier than anticipated.

items.zh: 我后来才知道她也在附近。
items.en: I only learned later that she was nearby too.
answers: I only learned later that she was nearby too.

items.zh: 我以为会议被取消了。
items.en: I assumed the meeting had been cancelled.
answers: I assumed the meeting had been cancelled.

items.zh: 他说的是周四，不是周二。
items.en: He meant Thursday, not Tuesday.
answers: He meant Thursday, not Tuesday.

items.zh: 我们各自以为对方带了票。
items.en: Each of us thought the other had the tickets.
answers: Each of us thought the other had the tickets.

items.zh: 笑声让我误以为大家在嘲笑我。
items.en: The laughter made me think they were mocking me.
answers: The laughter made me think they were mocking me.

items.zh: 那个手势其实是在指路。
items.en: The gesture was actually giving directions.
answers: The gesture was actually giving directions.

items.zh: 我把他的沉默理解为拒绝。
items.en: I took his silence as a refusal.
answers: I took his silence as a refusal.

items.zh: 名字相同造成了混淆。
items.en: The identical names caused confusion.
answers: The identical names caused confusion.

items.zh: 照片拍摄日期被看错了。
items.en: The photograph's date was misread.
answers: The photograph's date was misread.

items.zh: 解释清楚后，气氛轻松了。
items.en: The mood relaxed once it was explained.
answers: The mood relaxed once it was explained.

items.zh: 我们后来常拿这件事开玩笑。
items.en: We often joked about it afterwards.
answers: We often joked about it afterwards.

items.zh: 第一次尝试时，我们几乎没有取得进展。
items.en: We made little progress on our first attempt.
answers: We made little progress on our first attempt.
items.notes: make progress：取得进展；little 表示几乎没有。

items.zh: 我想放弃，但又试了一次。
items.en: I nearly gave up but tried again.
answers: I nearly gave up but tried again.

items.zh: 我们改变了顺序，终于奏效。
items.en: Changing the order finally worked.
answers: Changing the order finally worked.

items.zh: 小小的帮助让事情继续下去。
items.en: A little help kept things moving.
answers: A little help kept things moving.

items.zh: 结果并不完美，却足够使用。
items.en: The result was imperfect but usable.
answers: The result was imperfect but usable.

items.zh: 我们花的时间比计划多一倍。
items.en: We took twice as long as planned.
answers: We took twice as long as planned.

items.zh: 那次失败让我认真做准备。
items.en: That failure taught me to prepare properly.
answers: That failure taught me to prepare properly.

items.zh: 成功时没有人欢呼，大家只松了口气。
items.en: Nobody cheered; we simply felt relieved.
answers: Nobody cheered; we simply felt relieved.

items.zh: 我很庆幸自己没有太早下结论。
items.en: I was glad I had not drawn a conclusion too soon.
answers: I was glad I had not drawn a conclusion too soon.
I was glad I hadn't drawn a conclusion too soon.
items.notes: draw a conclusion：得出结论；过去完成时表示此前行为。

items.zh: 最后完成的人看起来反而最满意。
items.en: The last person to finish seemed the most satisfied.
answers: The last person to finish seemed the most satisfied.

items.zh: 小时候我常在那棵树下看书。
items.en: As a child, I often read under that tree.
answers: As a child, I often read under that tree.

items.zh: 祖父总把工具擦干净再收。
items.en: Grandad always cleaned his tools before storing them.
answers: Grandad always cleaned his tools before storing them.

items.zh: 那时街上几乎没有汽车。
items.en: There were hardly any cars then.
answers: There were hardly any cars then.

items.zh: 放学后我们会在门口等。
items.en: We would wait outside after school.
answers: We would wait outside after school.

items.zh: 我以前害怕在人前说话。
items.en: I used to fear speaking in public.
answers: I used to fear speaking in public.

items.zh: 我们搬家后习惯也变了。
items.en: Our routines changed after we moved.
answers: Our routines changed after we moved.

items.zh: 我仍能想起第一次学骑车。
items.en: I can still recall learning to ride.
answers: I can still recall learning to ride.

items.zh: 旧玩具唤起了许多细节。
items.en: The old toy brought back many details.
answers: The old toy brought back many details.

items.zh: 那家店早已不在了。
items.en: That shop has long since disappeared.
answers: That shop has long since disappeared.

items.zh: 小时候觉得漫长的那段路，现在走起来很短。
items.en: The walk that felt endless in childhood now seems short.
answers: The walk that felt endless in childhood now seems short.
items.notes: 定语从句对比童年和现在的感受。

items.zh: 她总是先听完再回答。
items.en: She always listened before answering.
answers: She always listened before answering.

items.zh: 他看起来严肃，其实很幽默。
items.en: He looked stern but was very humorous.
answers: He looked stern but was very humorous.

items.zh: 我记得的是她的耐心。
items.en: What I remember is her patience.
answers: What I remember is her patience.

items.zh: 他从不因为小失误责备人。
items.en: He never blamed people for minor mistakes.
answers: He never blamed people for minor mistakes.

items.zh: 她说得不多，却很有分量。
items.en: She spoke little, but her words carried weight.
answers: She spoke little, but her words carried weight.

items.zh: 他的声音在嘈杂中仍听得见。
items.en: His voice carried through the noise.
answers: His voice carried through the noise.

items.zh: 她对陌生人也很周到。
items.en: She was considerate even towards strangers.
answers: She was considerate even towards strangers.

items.zh: 他没有夸大自己的作用。
items.en: He did not exaggerate his role.
answers: He did not exaggerate his role.
He didn't exaggerate his role.

items.zh: 这次相遇改变了我的第一印象。
items.en: The encounter changed my first impression.
answers: The encounter changed my first impression.

items.zh: 我后来才理解那句忠告。
items.en: I understood that advice only later.
answers: I understood that advice only later.

items.zh: 现在回想，我本可以先问清楚。
items.en: Looking back, I could have asked first.
answers: Looking back, I could have asked first.

items.zh: 我把运气误当成了准备充分。
items.en: I mistook luck for good preparation.
answers: I mistook luck for good preparation.

items.zh: 那一刻我只看到了困难。
items.en: At that moment, I saw only the difficulty.
answers: At that moment, I saw only the difficulty.

items.zh: 事情没有按计划发展，但我仍从中学到了东西。
items.en: Things did not go to plan, but I still learned from them.
answers: Things did not go to plan, but I still learned from them.
Things didn't go to plan, but I still learned from them.

items.zh: 我不再认为求助是弱点。
items.en: I no longer see asking for help as weakness.
answers: I no longer see asking for help as weakness.

items.zh: 我们最初忽略了最简单的解释。
items.en: We initially overlooked the simplest explanation.
answers: We initially overlooked the simplest explanation.

items.zh: 这段经历让我更愿意倾听。
items.en: The experience made me more willing to listen.
answers: The experience made me more willing to listen.

items.zh: 并不是每个问题都需要立即解决。
items.en: Not every problem requires an immediate solution.
answers: Not every problem requires an immediate solution.

items.zh: 我后来学会给别人留时间。
items.en: I later learned to give people time.
answers: I later learned to give people time.

items.zh: 那件事的重要性是慢慢显现的。
items.en: Its significance became clear gradually.
answers: Its significance became clear gradually.

items.zh: 我们一直聊到天黑。
items.en: We talked until it grew dark.
answers: We talked until it grew dark.

items.zh: 最后留下的是一个简单的建议。
items.en: What remained was a simple suggestion.
answers: What remained was a simple suggestion.

items.zh: 那次之后我们再也没见面。
items.en: We never met again after that.
answers: We never met again after that.

items.zh: 故事还有我不知道的部分。
items.en: There are parts of the story I do not know.
answers: There are parts of the story I do not know.
There are parts of the story I don't know.

items.zh: 我只能讲述自己看到的。
items.en: I can only describe what I witnessed.
answers: I can only describe what I witnessed.

items.zh: 细节可能与她记得的不同。
items.en: The details may differ from her recollection.
answers: The details may differ from her recollection.

items.zh: 我不确定事情发生的确切年份。
items.en: I am unsure of the exact year.
answers: I am unsure of the exact year.

items.zh: 这不是故事的全部。
items.en: This is not the whole story.
answers: This is not the whole story.
This isn't the whole story.

items.zh: 当时不起眼的决定产生了长远影响。
items.en: A seemingly minor decision had lasting effects.
answers: A seemingly minor decision had lasting effects.

items.zh: 我至今仍记得离开时的轻松。
items.en: I still remember the relief when I left.
answers: I still remember the relief when I left.
